name: ghostswap-partners-api
description: Integrate the GhostSwap Partners API to add no-KYC crypto swaps (1,600+ coins, 0–4% partner fee, USDT payouts) into wallets, dApps, exchanges, payment flows, or affiliate sites. Covers Bearer auth, live quotes, idempotent swap creation, status polling, address validation, float and fixed-rate modes, error handling, and rate limits.
